message: Reviewing a scanned item is clearer. Each scan now asks "What is this?": a new item, or one you already have. A new item shows the name, brand and flavor you can edit. An item you already have keeps its own name, and a box at the bottom spells out what will be saved when you tap the button. A scan that only shares a word with one of your items ("Lime" in "Edamame Chili Lime Flavored") is no longer suggested as a match, and a guess you haven't accepted is added as a new item.
